description: Flat metadata schema for individual records derived from fungal biosynthetic gene cluster discovery, genome sequencing, gene-level cluster annotation, and secondary metabolite isolation/chemical analysis.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record.

record_type.descr: Type of record, e.g. organism_sample, genome_assembly, biosynthetic_gene_cluster, cluster_gene, metabolite_isolate, chemical_analysis.

project_name.descr: Name of the study or project generating the record.

sample_id.descr: Internal sample identifier for the fungal isolate or analyzed material.

isolate_id.descr: Identifier of the fungal isolate/strain, if applicable.

species_name.descr: Scientific name of the fungal species; use accepted binomial if known.

taxonomic_identification_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic identification, e.g. morphology, ITS barcode, phylogenomics.

taxonomy_confidence.descr: Confidence in taxonomic assignment, expressed as a percentage or score.

culture_collection_name.descr: Name of culture collection or repository holding the isolate, if applicable.

culture_collection_accession.descr: Accession or catalog number in the culture collection.

host_source.descr: Original source or host from which the fungus was obtained, e.g. soil, plant, marine substrate.

geographic_origin.descr: Geographic origin of the sample or isolate, as a place name or coordinates in text form.

collection_date.descr: Date when the fungal sample or isolate was collected.

collector_name.descr: Name of the person or team that collected the sample.

culture_conditions.descr: Growth medium and cultivation conditions used before DNA extraction or metabolite production, including temperature and time.

biosafety_level.descr: Biosafety level or containment category relevant to the fungal culture, if applicable.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol or kit used for fungal DNA extraction.

dna_input_amount_ng.descr: Amount of DNA used for library preparation, in nanograms.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, e.g. Illumina NovaSeq, PacBio Sequel II, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy, e.g. short-read, long-read, hybrid assembly.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs, if applicable.

insert_size_bp.descr: Expected library insert size in base pairs, if applicable.

raw_reads_accession.descr: Accession number for raw sequencing reads in a public repository.

assembly_id.descr: Identifier for the genome assembly derived from the sequencing data.

assembly_method.descr: Genome assembly software and workflow used.

assembly_version.descr: Version or release label of the assembly.

assembly_size_bp.descr: Total assembled genome size in base pairs.

scaffold_count.descr: Number of scaffolds in the assembly.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the assembly.

n50_bp.descr: N50 statistic of the assembly in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: Genome GC content as a percentage.

coverage_depth_x.descr: Mean sequencing coverage depth across the assembly, in fold coverage.

completeness_percent.descr: Assembly or genome completeness estimate, usually from BUSCO or similar, as a percentage.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated contamination level as a percentage.

annotation_pipeline.descr: Genome annotation pipeline used for gene prediction and functional annotation.

predicted_gene_count.descr: Total number of predicted protein-coding genes in the genome.

bgc_detection_tool.descr: Tool used to detect biosynthetic gene clusters, e.g. antiSMASH, DeepBGC.

bgc_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biosynthetic gene cluster within the genome.

bgc_contig_id.descr: Contig or scaffold identifier on which the biosynthetic gene cluster is located.

bgc_start_bp.descr: Start coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig, in base pairs.

bgc_end_bp.descr: End coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig, in base pairs.

bgc_length_bp.descr: Length of the biosynthetic gene cluster region in base pairs.

bgc_classification.descr: Biosynthetic class of the cluster, e.g. NRPS, PKS, terpene, hybrid, indole, RiPP.

bgc_subclass.descr: More specific subclass or domain architecture category, if available.

bgc_completeness.descr: Whether the cluster is complete, partial, or fragmented; store as text categories.

bgc_gene_count.descr: Number of genes within the biosynthetic gene cluster.

bgc_core_gene_count.descr: Number of core biosynthetic genes in the cluster.

bgc_similarity_to_known_cluster_percent.descr: Percent similarity to the nearest known cluster or reference BGC.

bgc_known_cluster_name.descr: Name or identifier of the closest known biosynthetic gene cluster, if any.

bgc_product_prediction.descr: Predicted natural product class or putative metabolite produced by the cluster.

bgc_prioritization_score.descr: Score used to rank cluster novelty or biosynthetic interest.

bgc_manual_curation_status.descr: Whether the cluster annotation was manually curated; use true or false.

gene_id.descr: Identifier of the gene within the genome or cluster.

gene_locus_tag.descr: Locus tag or systematic gene name.

gene_name.descr: Common gene name or assigned symbol, if available.

gene_start_bp.descr: Start coordinate of the gene on the contig, in base pairs.

gene_end_bp.descr: End coordinate of the gene on the contig, in base pairs.

gene_strand.descr: Gene strand orientation, use + or - as string values.

gene_product_name.descr: Predicted or annotated protein product name.

gene_function_category.descr: Functional category of the gene in the biosynthetic pathway, e.g. core enzyme, tailoring enzyme, regulator, transporter, resistance protein.

gene_role_in_bgc.descr: Specific role of the gene within the BGC, if assigned, e.g. adenylation, ketosynthase, methyltransferase, cyclase.

gene_domain_architecture.descr: Domain architecture of the encoded protein, described as a string or compact code.

gene_ec_number.descr: Enzyme Commission number for the gene product, if assigned.

gene_pfams.descr: Pfam or other conserved domain identifiers associated with the gene product.

gene_go_terms.descr: Gene Ontology terms associated with the gene product, encoded as a semicolon-separated string.

gene_homolog_name.descr: Closest characterized homolog used for functional inference.

gene_homology_identity_percent.descr: Percent amino acid identity to the closest homolog.

gene_homology_coverage_percent.descr: Alignment coverage to the closest homolog, as a percentage.

gene_expression_evidence.descr: Evidence for gene expression, e.g. RNA-seq, qPCR, proteomics, or none.

gene_expression_level.descr: Relative expression level or abundance value for the gene, if measured.

gene_knockout_phenotype.descr: Observed phenotype following gene disruption, if experimentally tested.

gene_is_essential_for_product.descr: Whether the gene is experimentally required for product formation.

cluster_regulatory_gene_present.descr: Whether a predicted regulatory gene is present in the cluster.

cluster_transporter_gene_present.descr: Whether a predicted transporter gene is present in the cluster.

metabolite_id.descr: Unique identifier for the isolated or detected secondary metabolite.

metabolite_name.descr: Name of the metabolite or provisional compound identifier.

metabolite_class.descr: Chemical class of the metabolite, e.g. polyketide, nonribosomal peptide, alkaloid, terpenoid.

metabolite_formula.descr: Molecular formula of the metabolite, if determined.

metabolite_exact_mass.descr: Exact monoisotopic mass of the metabolite, in Daltons.

metabolite_mz.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio in mass spectrometry.

metabolite_charge_state.descr: Observed ion charge state in mass spectrometry.

metabolite_purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the isolated metabolite as a percentage.

metabolite_yield_mg.descr: Yield of purified metabolite in milligrams.

metabolite_isolated.descr: Whether the metabolite was successfully isolated/purified.

metabolite_structure_determined.descr: Whether the chemical structure was experimentally determined.

metabolite_structure_method.descr: Method(s) used for structural elucidation, e.g. NMR, HRMS, X-ray crystallography.

metabolite_smiles.descr: SMILES representation of the metabolite structure, if available.

metabolite_inchi.descr: InChI representation of the metabolite structure, if available.

metabolite_inchi_key.descr: InChIKey representation of the metabolite structure, if available.

metabolite_bioactivity_assay.descr: Bioassay used to evaluate activity, e.g. antimicrobial, cytotoxicity, enzyme inhibition.

metabolite_activity_endpoint.descr: Measured activity endpoint, e.g. IC50, MIC, % inhibition.

metabolite_activity_value.descr: Numerical activity result from the assay.

metabolite_activity_unit.descr: Unit of the activity value, e.g. µM, ng/mL, %.

metabolite_activity_target.descr: Biological target or test organism for the bioactivity assay.

metabolite_toxicity_flag.descr: Whether the metabolite showed detectable toxicity in the assay system.

metabolite_proposed_biosynthetic_origin.descr: Proposed biosynthetic origin linking the metabolite to a cluster or pathway.

bgc_metabolite_link_confidence.descr: Confidence score supporting the link between the biosynthetic gene cluster and metabolite.

evidence_type.descr: Type of evidence supporting the BGC-metabolite association, e.g. gene knockout, correlation, heterologous expression, isotopic labeling.

evidence_strength.descr: Qualitative strength of evidence, e.g. weak, moderate, strong.

publication_doi.descr: DOI of the associated publication, if any.

data_repository.descr: Repository where related data are deposited, e.g. NCBI SRA, GenBank, GNPS, MetaboLights.

data_repository_accession.descr: Accession number in the referenced repository.

license.descr: Usage license for the record or associated data.

created_date.descr: Date the metadata record was created.

modified_date.descr: Date the metadata record was last modified.
